lead.notesHint: Yard size, gate code, what you'd like done

faq.q: Do I have to sign a contract for weekly mowing?
faq.a: No. Weekly mowing is month to month, and you can skip a week anytime by text.

faq.q: When is the best time to aerate and overseed?
faq.a: Early fall, from September to October, for the cool-season grasses common around Raleigh.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: No. Leave the gate unlocked or text us the code. We text you when we're done.

faq.q: Do you haul away leaves and debris?
faq.a: Yes. Cleanups include bagging and hauling everything away.
Card on file after each visit, or by invoice for projects.
